Synopsis:
    10-year Treasury yields hit their highest since November 2023 (4.857%), driven by disappointment over the Treasury's $6B long-dated buyback size. A strong $39B 10-year auction (2.71x bid-to-cover, highest since 2019) pulled yields off highs. Oil breaching $100/bbl is stoking inflation fears. PPI/CPI data due Thursday/Friday will be pivotal for the Fed's Sept 15-16 meeting, where futures now price ~60% odds of a rate hike.
